desc.zh: AI 搜索：理解并回答复杂查询——查询理解与改写、语义召回、多模态匹配、相关性与重排、RAG 链路、问答与深度研究；Agent 论文只收信息获取类（搜索 / RAG / 问答 / 深度研究），通用 Agent 不收。2026-10-24 起合并原检索与智能体搜索两个方向
desc.en: AI Search: understanding and answering complex queries — query understanding & rewriting, semantic retrieval, multimodal matching, relevance & reranking, RAG pipelines, QA & deep research. Agent papers only when the task is information-seeking (search, RAG, QA, deep research); generic agents are excluded. Merges the former Retrieval and Agentic tracks from 2026-10-24
